question: Will the July US jobs report beat expectations (85K+)?

model.prompt_context: Resolves YES if the headline nonfarm payrolls figure for July 2026, as first published in the BLS Employment Situation release on August 7, 2026 (bls.gov), is 85,000 or greater. Resolves NO if below 85,000. Only the initial headline print counts; later revisions are ignored. If the release is postponed past August 10, 2026, the market resolves based on the figure when published.

data_sources: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics – Employment Situation News Release (bls.gov/news.release/empsit.nr0.htm)
